run_main: run a Python file as __main__ with patched sys.argv and sys.path
run_main_subproc: run a Python script in a separate spawn process to avoid OpenGL context clashes
powerset: generate all combinations of an iterable from size zero to full length
test_example_modules: test Habitat Lab tutorial examples by running them in a subprocess
test_rearrange_example_modules: test Habitat rearrange example modules like interactive_play and gym tutorials in subprocess
